message.content: {"hts_code": "6210.10.9010", "reason": "The garments are protective suits of woven fabric designed to shield against chemical and flame hazards, which are classified under heading 6210 (garments made of fabrics of heading 5602, 5603, 5903, 5906, 5907 or 5911, or of flame-resistant/protective fabric) and specifically the 6210.10 subheading for such garments of fabric of heading 5602 or 5603 covering protection against fire, chemicals, or radiation, with the 9010 statistical suffix for protective garments of a type used by law enforcement and military personnel."}

predicted_reason: The garments are protective suits of woven fabric designed to shield against chemical and flame hazards, which are classified under heading 6210 (garments made of fabrics of heading 5602, 5603, 5903, 5906, 5907 or 5911, or of flame-resistant/protective fabric) and specifically the 6210.10 subheading for such garments of fabric of heading 5602 or 5603 covering protection against fire, chemicals, or radiation, with the 9010 statistical suffix for protective garments of a type used by law enforcement and military personnel.
